title: HDF Comparison Primitives
description: Types for representing structured comparisons between HDF security assessment documents.

Requirement_State.description: SARIF-compatible vocabulary extended for security. 'new' = present only in new source, 'absent' = present only in old, 'unchanged' = same effective status, 'updated' = status changed (generic), 'fixed' = was failing now passing, 'regressed' = was passing now failing, 'moved' = reorganized same content, 'split'/'merged' = reserved for v1.1.
Requirement_State.title: Requirement State

Change_Reason.description: The reason a requirement's state changed between sources.
Change_Reason.title: Change Reason

Comparison_Mode.description: The mode of comparison. 'temporal' compares the same target over time. 'baseline' compares against a golden reference. 'fleet' compares across multiple systems. 'multiSource' compares outputs from different scanners. 'baselineEvolution' compares two baseline documents to detect requirement changes between versions. 'systemDrift' compares two system documents to detect component-level changes.
Comparison_Mode.title: Comparison Mode

Source_Role.description: The role of a source document in the comparison.
Source_Role.title: Source Role

Original_Format.description: The original format of the source document before conversion to HDF.
Original_Format.title: Original Format

Match_Strategy.description: The strategy used to match requirements across sources. 'exactId' matches by identical IDs. 'mappedId' uses an ID mapping table. 'cciMatch'/'nistMatch' match by framework identifiers. 'fuzzyTitle'/'fuzzyContent' use text similarity.
Match_Strategy.title: Match Strategy

Conflict_Resolution.description: How a conflict between multiple scanner results was resolved.
Conflict_Resolution.title: Conflict Resolution

Annotation_Category.description: The category of an annotation attached to a comparison.
Annotation_Category.title: Annotation Category

path.description: JSON Pointer path to the changed field.

oldValue.description: The previous value of the field (for 'remove' and 'replace' operations).

newValue.description: The new value of the field (for 'add' and 'replace' operations).

Field_Change.description: A single field-level change between two versions of a requirement.
Field_Change.title: Field Change

role.description: The role of this source in the comparison.

label.description: Human-readable label for this source. Example: 'Before remediation scan'.

uri.description: URI pointing to the source document.

originalFormat.description: The original format of the source document before conversion to HDF.

checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum of the source document for integrity verification.

assessmentTimestamp.description: When the source assessment was performed. ISO 8601 format.

tool.description: The security tool that produced the assessment data in this source.

components.description: The components assessed in this source.

name.description: Name of the baseline used in this source.

version.description: Version of the baseline used in this source.

baselineRef.description: Reference to the baseline used in this source assessment.

Source.description: A source document participating in the comparison.
Source.title: Source

primaryStrategy.description: The primary strategy used to match requirements across sources.

fallbackStrategies.description: Ordered list of fallback strategies tried when the primary strategy fails to find a match.

minimumConfidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0-1) required to accept a match.

mappingTableUri.description: URI pointing to an external mapping table used for ID translation.

fingerprintFields.description: Fields used to compute a fingerprint for fuzzy matching.

Matching_Config.description: Configuration for how requirements are matched across sources.
Matching_Config.title: Matching Config

fixed.description: Number of requirements that changed from failing to passing.

regressed.description: Number of requirements that changed from passing to failing.

new.description: Number of requirements present only in the new source.

absent.description: Number of requirements present only in the old source.

unchanged.description: Number of requirements with the same effective status.

updated.description: Number of requirements with a generic status change.

moved.description: Number of requirements that were reorganized without content change.

State_Counts.description: Counts of requirements in each state.
State_Counts.title: State Counts

critical.description: State counts for critical severity requirements.

high.description: State counts for high severity requirements.

medium.description: State counts for medium severity requirements.

low.description: State counts for low severity requirements.

Severity_Breakdown.description: Breakdown of state counts by severity level.
Severity_Breakdown.title: Severity Breakdown

sourceIndex.description: Zero-based index into the sources array identifying which source this summary is for.

fixed.description: Number of requirements that changed from failing to passing.

regressed.description: Number of requirements that changed from passing to failing.

new.description: Number of requirements present only in the new source.

absent.description: Number of requirements present only in the old source.

unchanged.description: Number of requirements with the same effective status.

updated.description: Number of requirements with a generic status change.

moved.description: Number of requirements that were reorganized without content change.

Per_Source_Summary.description: Summary statistics for a single source in a multi-source comparison.
Per_Source_Summary.title: Per Source Summary

total.description: Total number of unique requirements across all sources.

matchedCount.description: Number of requirements successfully matched between sources.

unmatchedOldCount.description: Number of requirements in the old source with no match in the new source.

unmatchedNewCount.description: Number of requirements in the new source with no match in the old source.

new.description: Number of requirements present only in the new source.

absent.description: Number of requirements present only in the old source.

unchanged.description: Number of requirements with the same effective status.

updated.description: Number of requirements with a generic status change.

fixed.description: Number of requirements that changed from failing to passing.

regressed.description: Number of requirements that changed from passing to failing.

moved.description: Number of requirements that were reorganized without content change.

oldCompliancePercent.description: Compliance percentage of the old source (0-100).

newCompliancePercent.description: Compliance percentage of the new source (0-100).

averageMatchConfidence.description: Average confidence score across all requirement matches (0-1).

bySeverity.description: State counts broken down by severity level.

perSource.description: Summary statistics for each individual source in a multi-source comparison.

Comparison_Summary.description: Summary statistics for the overall comparison.
Comparison_Summary.title: Comparison Summary

name.description: Name of the baseline being compared.

state.title: Baseline Diff State
state.description: The state of this baseline in the comparison.

oldVersion.description: Version of the baseline in the old source.

newVersion.description: Version of the baseline in the new source.

mappingSource.description: The source of any ID mapping used to correlate requirements across baseline versions.

Baseline_Diff.description: Comparison of a baseline between sources.
Baseline_Diff.title: Baseline Diff

name.description: Component name used for matching across system versions.

state.title: Baseline Diff State
state.description: The state of this component in the comparison.

before.description: Component snapshot from the old system document. Null when state is 'new'.

after.description: Component snapshot from the new system document. Null when state is 'absent'.

fieldChanges.description: Detailed field-level changes between the before and after component snapshots.

Component_Diff.description: Comparison of a single component between two system document versions.
Component_Diff.title: Component Diff

purl.description: Package URL (purl) used as the identity key for matching across SBOMs.

state.title: Package Diff State
state.description: The state of this package: added (new in new SBOM), removed (absent from new SBOM), updated (version changed), unchanged.

oldVersion.description: Package version in the old SBOM.

newVersion.description: Package version in the new SBOM.

Package_Diff.description: Comparison of a single package between two SBOM versions, matched by purl.
Package_Diff.title: Package Diff

field.description: The field where the conflict occurs.

sourceIndex.description: Zero-based index into the sources array.

value.description: The value reported by this source for the conflicting field.

values.description: The conflicting values from each source.

resolvedIndex.description: Index of the source whose value was chosen as the resolution.

Scanner_Conflict.description: A conflict between scanner results for the same requirement.
Scanner_Conflict.title: Scanner Conflict

needsConfirmation.description: Whether this annotation requires human confirmation before acting on it.

Annotation.description: An annotation attached to a comparison, providing context or action items.
Annotation.title: Annotation

id.description: The canonical requirement identifier used for this diff.

state.description: The state of this requirement in the comparison.

changeReasons.description: The reasons for the state change.

before.description: The requirement as it appeared in the old/reference source. Null when state is 'new'.

after.description: The requirement as it appeared in the new source. Null when state is 'absent'.

fieldChanges.description: Detailed field-level changes between the before and after versions.

oldId.description: The requirement ID in the old source, if different from the canonical id.

newId.description: The requirement ID in the new source, if different from the canonical id.

title.description: The requirement title for human readability.

oldEffectiveStatus.description: The effective status of the requirement in the old source.

newEffectiveStatus.description: The effective status of the requirement in the new source.

oldImpact.description: The impact score of the requirement in the old source (0-1).

newImpact.description: The impact score of the requirement in the new source (0-1).

matchStrategy.description: The strategy that was used to match this requirement across sources.

matchManual.description: Whether the match was manually confirmed by a human.

annotationIds.description: IDs of annotations attached to this requirement diff.

sourceIndex.description: Index into the sources array for multi-source comparisons.

conflicts.description: Conflicts between multiple scanner results for this requirement.

beforeSensitive.description: Sensitive data from the old source that should not be included in the main before snapshot.

afterSensitive.description: Sensitive data from the new source that should not be included in the main after snapshot.

Requirement_Diff.description: A comparison of a single requirement between sources, including state, changes, and full before/after snapshots.
Requirement_Diff.title: Requirement Diff
